title: Seed data generator (FR-67) with post-seed verification
objective: An idempotent, deterministic seed command produces the full PRD 23.1 demo data set — tenant, users, brokers, parties, leads, quotes, follow-ups, pricing approvals, status histories, and alert-triggering conditions — verified by an automated post-seed check (spec FR-67).
scope: dotnet run --project src/api/QuoteIQ.Api -- seed entry point (never runs implicitly)
Deterministic generation (fixed RNG seed) meeting every FR-67 minimum and distribution
Plausible append-only status history for every lead and quote
SeedVerifier asserting all minimums and alert-category coverage
out_of_scope: Startup seeding of permission catalog / global template (T-005/T-009, always-on)
implementation_details: Infrastructure/Seeding/SeedCommand.cs dispatched from Program.cs args; SeedOptions {rngSeed=20260711}; idempotency: natural-key upserts (tenant by name 'The Brittany', users by email, brokers/parties by name, leads by seeded external ref 'SEED-####') so re-runs converge to the same state

Builders: SeedUsers (15: 1 Internal, 1 Tenant Admin, 1 Sales Head, 6 RMs, 3 Underwriters, 1 Sales Ops, 2 Executive Viewers — creates roles per PRD 20.4 recommended set with sensible permission bundles, Keycloak users with a documented demo password flow), SeedBrokers (18 across Tier 1/2/3/Direct with contacts; volume/performance skew flags), SeedParties (200 across types/segments/industries/regions, ~8 strategic, existing/new mix), SeedLeads (300: ~135 open weighted mid-pipeline incl. >=5 unassigned New; ~45 Closed Won with Won quote + bound premium; ~75 Closed Lost across the full Appendix C reason taxonomy with pre-/post-quote and competitor data; ~30 Expired; ~15 Withdrawn; >=15 high-value overlapping), SeedQuotes (500 across all statuses, 1.5-2 per quoted lead with revisions/options; >=40 Sent-open with valid-until inside/past the expiry window), SeedFollowUps (400 incl. several overdue), SeedPricingApprovals (40: ~20 approved incl. on Won leads, ~10 rejected with >=3 re-request-then-approved loops, ~10 pending of which >=5 beyond target)

StatusHistorySynthesizer: for each lead/quote, generates a plausible dated operation sequence consistent with its final state (dates spanning 6-12 months back, monotonic, turnaround-realistic) writing lead_status_history/quote_status_history and setting date fields (date_assigned, sent_date, decision_date, last_activity_at) from the synthesized events

Cross-cutting: >=20 records per main risk rule (stalled, overdue follow-up, expiring quote, SLA breach, high value, unassigned) and >=5 per remaining alert type (pending pricing approval, awaiting underwriting, executive escalation); premiums plausible BWP (50k - 15M range by product line); spread across all reference dimensions

After generation: runs AlertEvaluationJob once, then SeedVerifier: asserts every FR-67 minimum count, every lifecycle bucket, every alert category non-empty per 23.1 cross-cutting table, every dashboard endpoint returns non-empty widgets; exits non-zero with a violation report otherwise
README.dev.md updated with seed instructions + demo credentials note

findings.description: SeedVerifier.VerifyDashboardWidgets is a deliberately self-skipping, always-passing informational check because the dashboard endpoints (T-031..T-036) do not exist yet. This is correctly gated and clearly flagged (not a fabricated pass): it records a single SKIPPED check with an explanatory detail rather than silently omitting the requirement or failing the whole verifier. Non-blocking for T-041, whose data-side minimums are all genuinely asserted and empirically pass. Carry-forward: this sub-check MUST be re-enabled/replaced with real per-endpoint HTTP assertions for T-042 once the dashboard endpoints land, so the PRD 23.1 'every dashboard returns non-empty widgets' POC success standard is actually enforced.
findings.evidence: src/api/QuoteIQ.Infrastructure/Seeding/SeedVerifier.cs lines 201-210 (VerifyDashboardWidgets adds a check with Passed:true and Detail 'SKIPPED: no dashboards.* endpoint is mapped yet...'); README.dev.md 'Deferred verification scope' section documents the same. Original task history entry (2026-07-14T02:40:00) instructed this deferral.
findings.suggested_fix: In T-042, replace the VerifyDashboardWidgets body with real HTTP calls against each mapped dashboards.* route asserting non-empty widget payloads, and re-run SeedVerifier against seeded data.

history.message: Task generated from approved spec.md (FR-67, PRD 23.1)

AC-066/AC-071.

Implementor delivered: SeedOptions/SeedConstants (FR-67 minimums centralized, no magic numbers), StatusHistorySynthesizer (pure, DB-free; builds legal monotonic lead/quote operation sequences by walking LeadWorkflow's progression rungs + reusing QuoteLeadCascade's exact lead-cascade string codes, validated at every step against LeadWorkflow.IsLegal/QuoteWorkflow.IsLegal), SeedReferenceCatalog + SeedPremiums helpers, Builders/{SeedUsers,SeedBrokers,SeedParties,SeedLeads,SeedQuotes,SeedFollowUps,SeedPricingApprovals}.cs, SeedCommand.cs (orchestrator, direct Store-interface writes rather than full CQRS/mediator dispatch - flagged deliberate choice, see below), SeedVerifier.cs, SeedingServiceCollectionExtensions.cs, Program.cs `-- seed` CLI dispatch (starts host, runs SeedCommand, runs SeedVerifier, exits non-zero on violation, never calls app.Run()), README.dev.md seed section. Tests: 29 unit theory cases (StatusHistorySynthesizerTests, pure/no-DB) covering every lead/quote terminal+open state incl. both closed-lost-via-quote and closed-lost-before-quote branches; 5 integration tests (SeedTests.cs, real Postgres+Keycloak Testcontainers per TenantSeedingTests/KeycloakAdminServiceTests conventions) exactly matching the task's test_plan, all passing. Full backend suite after this change: Domain.Tests 328/328, Application.Tests 28/28, Api.Tests 265/265, Infrastructure.Tests 91/91 (712/712 total; baseline was 678/678, net +34 = the 29 unit + 5 integration tests added). DEFERRED PER PRIOR INSTRUCTION: SeedVerifier.VerifyDashboardWidgets is a clearly-marked, self-skipping, always-passing informational check (dashboard endpoints T-031..T-036 do not exist yet); re-run/replace once they land. FLAGGED DEVIATIONS FROM THE LITERAL BRIEF (not silently resolved): (1) SeedCommand writes leads/quotes/follow-ups/pricing-approvals directly via the existing Infrastructure Store interfaces + StatusHistorySynthesizer rather than dispatching the CQRS workflow-operation commands (LeadOperationExecutor/QuoteOperationExecutor) — those handlers hardcode DateTimeOffset.UtcNow for every history/date field with no backdating seam, which is incompatible with FR-67's 6-12-month-spread requirement; Users/Tenant/Roles/BusinessAssignments still go through the real command-handler-equivalent hooks (IKeycloakAdminService, ITenantStore.CreateAsync, ITenantProvisioningHook, IRoleStore, IBusinessAssignmentStore.ReplaceAsync) for genuine invariant enforcement. (2) Idempotency for leads/quotes/follow-ups/pricing-approvals is coarse-grained at the dataset level (a bulk pre-fetch of existing SEED-#### external refs, not a per-record natural-key upsert for every one of the ~1,240 lead-dependent rows) — proven correct by Seed_RunTwice_ShouldBeIdempotent, but not a literal per-record upsert as the brief's prose suggested; tenant/users/brokers/parties DO use genuine per-record natural-key upserts. (3) PRD 23.1's own arithmetic is not fully self-consistent (500 quotes at a realistic ~1.5-2x ratio is unreachable against the ~130-150 leads its own lifecycle distribution sends to a quote); resolved by treating the 500-quote minimum as authoritative and adding extra plausible draft/withdrawn quotes via a top-up pass, documented in SeedQuotes' doc comment. (4) Demo credentials: no fixed demo password is set (would require extending IKeycloakAdminService outside T-041's scope); seeded users complete the same Keycloak reset-password-email flow as any real invited user, documented in README.dev.md. Ready for Evaluator review against AC-066/AC-071, V-066/V-071.

RULE on the 4 flagged deviations: (1) direct Store writes bypassing CQRS workflow handlers for backdating - acceptable given the UtcNow hardcode? confirm invariants still hold via the synthesizer's IsLegal gating; (2) coarse dataset-level idempotency for the ~1,240 dependent rows vs literal per-record upsert - acceptable given Seed_RunTwice proves convergence? (3) treating 500 quotes as authoritative over PRD 23.1's inconsistent arithmetic via a top-up pass; (4) no fixed demo password (reset-email flow) - acceptable vs FR-67/PRD 23.1 demo-credential intent, or a finding? Also confirm the dashboard-widget verifier deferral (self-skipping informational until T-031..T-036) is correctly gated and flagged, not a fabricated pass - and that it MUST be re-enabled for T-042.
